name: pr-pitcrew
description: A pit crew for your pull requests: bug review, security review and a browser-driven acceptance test, as GitHub Actions you can pin.
//: No dependencies, and none are wanted. This runs inside GitHub Actions, where a composite action gets no install step: every dependency would have to be vendored into the repository or fetched at run time in a job that holds the model key. Node's own test runner and fetch are enough.
